description: Recommends YMCA operate East Side Leisure Centre.
Includes expanded fitness area and more pool lanes.
Explores funding for additional pool lanes.

chips.text: Option 1 requires up to $11.7 million additional capital.
Mayor Block emphasized building for future value, not just cost.
Saskatoon Goldfins and other swim clubs are affected.
Committee recommended Option 1, administration recommended Option 2.
Historical practice of building beyond existing demand is unclear.
Public speakers highlighted severe pressure on aquatic space.
Design considers culturally sensitive spaces for diverse communities.

speakers.name: Ryan Lejbak
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: East Side Leisure Centre - YMCA Operating Proposal
said: Saskatoon pools are over capacity, creating long waitlists for lessons.
Building a 6-lane pool replaces a 6-lane pool, not planning for future.
A 10-lane pool offers more options and revenue; Goldfins will contribute.

speakers.name: Jennifer Robinson
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: East Side Leisure Centre - YMCA Operating Proposal
said: Saskatoon has produced world-class aquatic athletes, inspiring future generations.
Increased interest in swimming strains current facilities, causing waitlists.
A 10-lane facility supports diverse programming, health, and employment opportunities.
